blocks.text: VIGAN CITY, Ilocos Sur — Vigan celebrated its heritage, arts, and living traditions through a cultural and heritage exhibit held as part of the World Heritage Cities Solidarity and Cultural Celebration and Tourism Week 2026. Held at Balay Bigueño along Calle Crisologo, the exhibit featured artworks, traditional crafts, and other expressions of Vigan’s cultural identity. A major attraction was the collection of works by 25 finalists in the Vigan Heritage Painting Competition, who interpreted the city’s architecture, history, traditions and heritage through their paintings.
